action.details: Opens chatgpt.com with up to 8,000 selected characters encoded into the website's q parameter. It does not call the OpenAI API or select a hard-coded model.
action.exampleInput: Explain why the sky appears blue.
action.exampleOutput: ChatGPT opens a new conversation containing the selected text.
action.name: ChatGPT Website
action.privacySummary: The selected text is sent to chatgpt.com as part of the URL when you run the action.
action.requirements: Online Actions must be enabled. ChatGPT sign-in may be required. Selections longer than 8,000 characters may exceed the website handoff limit.
action.summary: Start a new ChatGPT conversation with the selected text.
